digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate + Gerrit DET code-review criterion
propositions: Complex bug fixes with non-test file changes bypass substantive review under the light advisory tier, allowing design changes to ship with only advisory DET findings
Bug-fix commits exceeding 150 non-test lines lack a blocking review gate at Gerrit to catch undeclared or misattested large changes

The blast-radius escalation for explicit review-plan <bug> must route through a single shared helper keyed on persisted file_impact to cover both precheck and route_criteria enforcement seams plus the batch-runner caller, without CLI flags or step-input schema changes

The Gerrit DET backstop criterion must verify plan-review attestations cross-host using opcert machinery (verify_opcert + trusted_env_keyring), then apply compute_validity freshness checks, accepting only certified/stale-code/stale-head verdicts and blocking undeclared or stale attestations with a teaching message

Non-test line classification (tests/** and conftest.py excluded, everything else counted) and the 150-line threshold must be defined once and shared by both B1 escalation logic and the B2 backtest predicate
